# teams_external_access_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing ExternalAccessConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `block_external_user_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -BlockExternalUserAccess parameter.
- `blocked_users` (String) Maps to the -BlockedUsers parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
